outcome: Anthropometric birth outcomes (weight, length, head circumference)
cohort: 2382 mother-child pairs participating in the INfancia y Medio Ambiente (INMA) Project
finding: Sufficient circulating vitamin D concentration in pregnancy may reduce the risk of cesarean section by obstructed labor, but was not associated with other measured outcomes.
mod_finding: Sufficient circulating vitamin D concentration in pregnancy may reduce the risk of cesarean section by obstructed labor.
gest_age: Mean 13.5 weeks at time of 25(OH)D3 measurement
